text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see. Lately, I keep dreaming 
about portable shrines and kicking the 
wall awake.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm wide awake and can't fall back asleep, 
and it feels like the wall's about to 
crack, too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... What a troublesome sleeping 
posture, seriously!
